signal: Dovetail Software ranked #1 in HR Service Delivery vendor satisfaction for the fifth straight year and shipped its generative-AI HR Copilot, deepening its Workday partnership.

email.body1:
Kevin, saw Dovetail took #1 in HR Service Delivery satisfaction again and shipped the generative-AI HR Copilot.

A win like that usually means more accounts in your target market than the team can work, especially across the Workday ecosystem. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Dovetail off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kevin, quick follow-up for Dovetail.

With the Copilot launch and the Workday momentum, the number probably climbed faster than reps can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Dovetail needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kevin, last bit of proof for Dovetail.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Dovetail's reply rate likely compares to peer HR-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kevin, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know a sales calendar fills up fast right after a product launch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Dovetail's motion? I will tailor it to you either way.
